curation.why: case_class_pattern is a destructuring pattern in a match (`LineItem(_, amount, true)`), not a class definition — it only looks like one because it has a 'type' field and holds patterns, and labelling it 'class' would put a spurious type in the summary. class_parameter/class_parameters are constructor-parameter wrappers. val_definition and var_definition name a 'type', not a name. import_declaration declares nothing nestable. The two dropped labels are expression kinds that add nothing to a summary. Note package_clause and function_definition are now OBSERVED containers rather than curated in, because the sample uses the braced package form and nests a local def.
